seoTitle: How to Connect Asana to Power BI Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to link Asana with Microsoft Power BI in 2026 using the native data connector to build cross-project dashboards and scheduled refresh reports.
intro: When Asana's built-in dashboards aren't enough for executive reporting, pulling your project data into Power BI opens up far more flexible analysis. This guide covers connecting the native Asana data connector, importing portfolios and projects, and scheduling automatic refreshes so your visuals stay current.

steps.heading: Open Get Data in Power BI Desktop
steps.body: Launch Power BI Desktop and open the Get Data panel to locate the native Asana data connector.

steps.heading: Authenticate your Asana account
steps.body: Sign in and approve the workspace data access permissions Power BI requests to connect to your Asana account.

steps.heading: Select your portfolios and projects
steps.body: Use the Power BI Navigator window to choose the specific portfolios, team spaces, or projects you want to import.

steps.heading: Review the imported field mappings
steps.body: Check how Power BI maps your Asana task fields, custom columns, assignees, and milestones into the data model.

steps.heading: Build visuals and schedule refreshes
steps.body: Design your progress and resource tracking charts, then configure a scheduled automatic refresh in Power BI Service to keep the dashboard current.

faq.question: Do I need a Power BI Pro license to connect Asana?
faq.answer: You can build reports in Power BI Desktop for free, but sharing dashboards and scheduling automatic refreshes through Power BI Service typically requires a Pro or Premium license.

faq.question: How often can I refresh Asana data in Power BI?
faq.answer: Refresh frequency depends on your Power BI Service plan, with more frequent scheduled refreshes generally available on higher tiers.

faq.question: Can I combine data from multiple Asana portfolios in one report?
faq.answer: Yes, you can import several portfolios or projects and combine them within the same Power BI data model for consolidated reporting.

faq.question: Will custom fields from Asana show up in Power BI?
faq.answer: Yes, custom tracking columns and fields you've set up in Asana are included in the data Power BI imports.
